Hi Kadi Fofana, your supervisor flagged this week's screening numbers — almost none of the children you measured screened as malnourished, which is unusual for your area. Can we talk through which households you visited?
Coach · 2026-05-12T09:02:00
Mostly the compounds near the health post — they are the quickest to reach and I can do more visits in a day.
Kadi Fofana · 2026-05-12T09:18:00
That explains the pattern. The families closest to the health post tend to be better off — the children most at risk are usually in the farther households. Could you plan next week's route to include the outer settlements?
Coach · 2026-05-12T09:21:00
Yes, I can do the far side on Tuesday and Wednesday when I have more time for the walk.
Kadi Fofana · 2026-05-12T09:29:00
Checking back in — this week's screening profile looks much more like the area's expected picture, including two referrals that got children into treatment. That's exactly the change we hoped for.
Coach · 2026-05-19T08:40:00
The route plan helped. The far households take longer but those visits matter more.
Kadi Fofana · 2026-05-19T08:52:00
Agreed. Closing this task as resolved — keep that route rotation going, Kadi Fofana.
